summary: evidence-gc never deletes a dead tree or input key whose newest record is younger than grace_hours; soft_records no longer deletes anything (it removed every in-grace group once the live set outgrew it, including the first records of a signing run in progress, #4186); the summary gains grace_records

replay.detail: No claim replay or recovery behavior changes.

schema.detail: No tables, indexes, triggers, schema-version changes or data rewrites. The GC summary and plan gain grace_records.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rules or digest changes. GC deletes strictly less: nothing younger than grace_hours. .st/evidence-retention.json is unchanged and soft_records is still read and checked.

compatibility.detail: The GC timer runs main's evidence-gc, so this applies at the next run once on main.

manual.detail: The evidence-gc timer on the build host that runs it was disabled on 2026-10-29 until this lands: re-enable it (systemctl --user enable --now evidence-gc.timer) after merge, and remove ~/.local/state/evidence-gc/PAUSED.
